title: Feature: mdview polish, accessibility, "open from anywhere", and delightful reader features

open_questions.question: Q1: Allow any network use for opening links (mdview://open?url= one-time fetch of raw GitHub Markdown)?
open_questions.default: No. Keep zero network and the 'never connects' claim; if links matter later, use Universal Links on a khgouldy.github.io user site with the content in the link fragment (no app request).

open_questions.question: Q2: Can Grok Bot send Markdown as a .md file attachment (MIME text/markdown) instead of, or as well as, inline text?
open_questions.default: Yes, change the bot (outside this repo). It makes Share -> mdview work in any chat app with a share sheet.

open_questions.question: Q3: Pull the Action extension (V1, V2) into the Nov 10 launch build?
open_questions.default: No. Launch with Paste Markdown and the How to Open Files guide; submit 0.2.0 with the extension right after launch.

open_questions.question: Q4: Build the Quick Look preview extension anyway, for iOS 18-26 users?
open_questions.default: Not now. iOS 27 does not invoke third-party Markdown preview extensions (FB24481377). Revisit if 27.x fixes it.

open_questions.question: Q5: Keep the launch version at 0.1.0 (build 2)?
Q6: Turn on math rendering by default in v0.2?
open_questions.default: No, off by default: dollar amounts would render as math.

open_questions.question: Q7: Show 'Save to Files' in the pasted reader (mdview then writes a new file the user chose)?
open_questions.default: Yes. It never changes existing files, so 'never changes them' still holds.

open_questions.question: Q8: If iPad drag and drop fails on device (L12), drop the claim rather than fix it before launch?
open_questions.default: Yes, drop the claim for launch and file a v0.2 bead.

open_questions.question: Q9: Are there localized App Store listings kept only in App Store Connect?
open_questions.default: Assume none; if there are, keving copies the L11 listing changes there by hand in L12.

deferred.when: after iOS 27.x fixes FB24481377, or if keving wants it for iOS 26 devices (Q4)
deferred.note: iOS 27 does not invoke third-party preview extensions for net.daringfireball.markdown.

deferred.item: mdview:// URL scheme and Universal Links

deferred.item: Relative .md links, wikilink resolution, folder/vault browsing and cross-file search

beads.title: Render task lists as read-only checkboxes
beads.description: Launch-critical. See plan.md section 5, bead L6. Foundation's parser has no task lists, so `- [ ]` shows as text. TaskListPreprocessor rewrites a list item's leading [ ]/[x]/[X] into `![Not done](x-mdview-task:unchecked)` / `![Done](x-mdview-task:checked)`, skipping fenced and indented code. RenderPipeline.prepare(_:obsidian:math:) runs Obsidian, then TaskList, then RemoteImages; RenderedView calls only it. LocalImageLoader returns AnyAttachment and handles x-mdview-task: URLs with TaskCheckbox (an SF Symbol about 1 em, 'Done'/'Not done' labels, not tappable) before ImagePolicy, which stays file-only. If the attachment misaligns, fall back to ☐/☑ glyphs and say so in the handoff.
acceptance: `swift test --package-path Packages/MDCore` passes TaskListPreprocessor tests: unchecked, checked and uppercase X; -, *, + and ordered markers; nesting; fenced code unchanged; mid-sentence [ ] unchanged; `[x](url)` unchanged; CRLF kept
RenderPipelineTests show front matter removed before the task rewrite and remote images still linkified
An ImagePolicy test asserts `x-mdview-task:checked` is rejected (policy unchanged)
RenderedView.markdownForDisplay calls RenderPipeline.prepare, and LocalImageLoader returns TaskCheckbox for x-mdview-task URLs before any file access
`make test` and `make lint` exit 0

beads.title: Remember reading position per file
beads.description: v0.2. See plan.md section 5, bead V6. MDCore ReadingPositionStore sits behind an injected KeyValueStorage protocol. It stores a scroll fraction per SHA-256 hash of the standardized path, as JSON under reader.positions, LRU-capped at 200, clamped to 0 to 1, and records nothing below 0.02. RenderedView reads the fraction with onScrollGeometryChange (debounced 1 s) and restores once after first layout with ScrollPosition, only for documents with a file URL. privacy.md describes the data (on device, path hash, 200 files).
acceptance: `swift test --package-path Packages/MDCore` passes ReadingPositionStore tests: round trip, clamping, the 0.02 floor, pruning at 201 entries, a stable hash, `/a/../b.md` standardized
RenderedView records and restores position only when ReaderContext/documentConfiguration has a file URL
docs/privacy.md describes stored reading positions
`make test` and `make lint` exit 0

beads.title: Export to PDF and print

Letter is used for US/CA/MX regions, A4 elsewhere. Documents over 1 MB show 'Too long to export'. No new dependencies, no network.
